gloss: to finish, to get by with

notes:
{済|す}ます is a godan verb meaning to finish/complete or to get by/make do with something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (intransitive - to be finished, to be enough)

SENSE 1 - TO FINISH/COMPLETE:
- ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{済|す}ます: to finish homework
- ⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{済|す}ます: to finish errands
- ⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払：03193_shiharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{済|す}ます: to complete payment
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{済|す}ませる: to finish preparations

SENSE 2 - TO GET BY WITH:
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{済|す}ます: to make do with bread
- ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{済|す}ます: to get by with something cheap
- 〜ないで{済|す}ます: to get by without ~
- ⟦{謝|あやま}らないで→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧{済|す}ます: to get by without apologizing

ASPECT (ている):
- {済|す}ませてから: after finishing
- {済|す}ませた: finished (completed)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧: to be finished/done; to suffice
- ⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧/⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧: to end/finish (general)
